matched: bi-degree (2,2) (rational); topology: one open tangential circular arc from the blue's left edge to its right edge, the orange touching the blue from behind (blue in front everywhere, as in the AA-GPU panel); appearance fitted to the Surfaces panel (camera and IoU in 'fit'): square-ish domed blue seen from slightly below, dome-shaped orange outline through it, arched red curve
guessed: surface types (two coaxial spheroids sharing their equator) and all extents are fitted to the picture; the blue's rounded top-left corner, its slightly concave right edge and the orange's two small horns beyond that edge are not reproduced
paper_other_methods: paper: the open-source kernel and the spline library returned nothing
truth_method: closed form: r_blue(z) > r_orange(z) for z != 0, equal at z = 0, so the intersection is the unit circle z = 0 restricted to the common longitude range
